articles.title: Dealmaker Orcel's decades-long quest to shake up European banking
articles.summary: MILAN/FRANKFURT, Nov 20 (Reuters) - Andrea Orcel had a point to prove in trying to redraw Europe's banking landscape, after notably failing at his first attempt with a blockbuster deal that led to the carve-up of ABN Amro nearly 20 years ago. Victory this week in his two-year fight to ‌take over Germany's Commerzbank marks the culmination of three decades of dealmaking for Orcel and puts the UniCredit CEO firmly at the centre of Europe's banking map.

articles.title: Germany agrees terms with Italy's UniCredit for Commerzbank takeover
articles.summary: UniCredit and the German government said Thursday they had agreed on terms for the Italian bank's takeover of German rival Commerzbank, a key step towards completing the hotly disputed merger.Commerzbank and the German government initially resisted, but with UniCredit having built up a stake approaching 50 percent, their focus has now shifted to getting the best possible terms.
